summary: Pass at b661e01f, which is the current HEAD. The audited change e18baa25 adds two refusals to writeMuseDelivery and changes no other line. The duplicate row id refusal names the row id and runs before the first print read and before the first write. The symlinked delivery root refusal names the path and runs before the mkdir. Both refusals reach the CLI error path, which writes the message to stderr and exits 1. A normal run still works: the week 1 list holds 30 distinct row ids, and the delivery folder is a real directory. The fileVersion rule and the PM decision A hold. One nonblocking nit remains: the contract names no deliver command.

It holds no entry for the deliver command, which the CLI accepts (src/storytime/book-pictures.ts:4628) and runs at lines 4726-4755 with the flags --list, --approvals, --muse and --delivery (src/storytime/book-pictures.ts:4637, 4729). The contract holds no deliver refusal rule either, so the two new refusals live only in the code and in plan.md:5199-5212. evidence: Provenance: git rev-parse HEAD returned b661e01f946dc4ef6ebab78a64985b6c6a58035e, the audited HEAD, and git log shows it as the newest commit. git rev-parse 15a7bf0b returned 15a7bf0b2a59b8137a05805666df6736dc256167, the phase base. role_base_sha equals the audited HEAD. Every Forge source read used git show b661e01f:<path>, so the audit rests on the audited HEAD.

Scope: the phase range 15a7bf0b..b661e01f holds the production commit e18baa25 (src/storytime/muse-delivery.ts, 12 lines added) and the evidence commit b661e01f. The audited change adds two refusals and touches no other line.

Duplicate row refusal: writeMuseDelivery builds a set of row ids from options.rows and throws 'The picture list holds the row <id> twice.' (src/storytime/muse-delivery.ts:341-346). The message names the row id. The check runs after the approval file is read and before the first print read, before the delivered-name loop, and before the first write.

Symlinked delivery root refusal: the writer calls lstat on the delivery root and throws 'The delivery folder <path> is a symlink; the writer refuses it.' (src/storytime/muse-delivery.ts:348-351). The message names the absolute path. The check runs before the mkdir at line 488 and before the writes at lines 489 and 490.

Exit code: the deliver block in runStorytimeCli holds no catch (src/storytime/book-pictures.ts:4726-4755), so a refusal reaches runStorytimeBookPicturesEntry. That function redacts the message, writes it to stderr, and returns 1. The entry sets process.exitCode to that code, so the command exits non-zero.

Writes nothing: both refusals stand before the mkdir at src/storytime/muse-delivery.ts:488, so a refused run creates no delivery folder and no file. The ADV9 probe asserts the same at tests/storytime-muse-delivery-adversarial.test.ts:567.
Normal run, new folder: a missing delivery root makes lstat return ENOENT, so lstatOrNull returns null and the root check passes. The writer creates the folder at line 488 as before.
Normal run, same folder: out/storytime/l2/unit1/w01/delivery-muse-v1 and out/storytime/l2/unit1/w01/delivery-muse-v2 are real directories, not symlinks, so the new root check accepts them.

Normal run, same manifest: the writer reads the existing manifest.json, compares the bytes, and keeps the file when the bytes match (src/storytime/muse-delivery.ts:455-464). A rerun over the same folder writes no file and returns the manifest.
Normal run, row set: the picture list holds 196 rows with 196 distinct ids, and the week 1 set holds 30 rows with 30 distinct ids. The new duplicate check accepts the operator run.

Operator approval list: docs/storytime/l2-unit1/w01/muse/approved.json holds 30 entries, one per week 1 row, and it pins the picture list SHA-256 6d05dfc596c7f1891577a800a9375228136acc332c7c8b975c9df0bf6c062a58. The measured SHA-256 of the Workbooks list file equals that pin and the contract pin at contract.md:10-11.

FileVersion rule: contract.md:24-26 states that an approval entry with fileVersion N delivers <row id>-vN.png and <row id>-line-vN.png from one candidate at version N. The code keeps that rule in deliveredNames (src/storytime/muse-delivery.ts:188-204), which replaces the -v<n>.png suffix and sets the candidate version. The change e18baa25 touches no line of that rule.

Decision A: contract.md:28-30 states that the Workbooks stage 1 reader matches a manifest entry by the row id and that Workbooks owns that change. The Forge side provides the row id: manifestJob copies rowCaptureJob, which sets id to row.id (src/storytime/muse-delivery.ts:326-329, src/storytime/book-pictures.ts:3611-3629). The week 1 v2 manifest holds 30 jobs, 26 at version 1 and 4 at version 2, with the batches w01/color and w01/lineart.

Delivered names in the production folder: the week 1 v2 manifest gives the 4 fileVersion rows the names <row id>-v2.png and <row id>-line-v2.png, and the folder holds 60 PNG files. The 26 other rows keep the -v1 names.

RCV2-1 withdrawn: the PM decision A of 2026-11-02, 03:1x ICT, assigns the stage 1 row match to the Workbooks reader, and the contract records that decision at contract.md:28-30. The Forge manifest at the audited HEAD gives every job the row id as job.id, so the finding stays closed and is not re-raised.

The Forge side takes the row set from the list and the week filter (src/storytime/book-pictures.ts:4743-4748), so the finding stays closed and is not re-raised.

Contract gap: the Commands section runs from contract.md:43 to the next heading at line 86. It lists eight commands and no deliver entry. The word deliver appears only at contract.md:24 and contract.md:25, inside the fileVersion rule.
Plan evidence: the remediation block records both fixes, the 190 of 190 test result, and the mutation proof (measure/tracks/asset_storytime_l2_unit1_pictures_20261025/plan.md:5199-5212).
